name: 鹭羽泽
Egret Marsh
before: 东南的沼泽里栖着成百上千只白鹭，一伙山外来的猎户张着毒箭，专射白鹭取它背上的蓑羽，拿去卖给城里做帽缨。泽面上漂着拔光了毛的鹭鸟，猎户们站在齐腰深的泥水里，见有人来，弓就转了过来。阿扎急着找泉眼，一脚踩进了他们的箭道里。

Hundreds upon hundreds of egrets roost in the south-eastern marsh, and hunters from beyond the hills are shooting them with poisoned arrows for the fine plumes on their backs, to sell in the cities for hat tassels. Plucked birds float on the water while the hunters stand waist-deep in mud and swing their bows round at anyone who comes. In her hurry to find the spring, A Zha has stepped right into their line of fire.
after: 猎户被赶出了泽地，剩下的白鹭又落回了水上。一个猎户说，泽里冬天别处结冰，只有一处泉眼不冻，鹭鸶冬天都挤在那儿：「水从地底下冒上来，冬天摸着是暖的，夏天摸着是凉的。」他朝东一指，那片白鹭最密的地方就是。

The hunters driven out of the marsh, the surviving egrets settle back on the water. One hunter says that in winter, when the rest of the marsh freezes, one spring never does, and the egrets all crowd round it. 'The water comes up from under the ground. Warm to the touch in winter, cool in summer.' He points east: wherever the egrets are thickest, that's it.

name: 封念堂
The Sealing Hall
before: 落水洞下游死路尽头一座竹堂，是封念人的老窝，堂里摆着一张长案，案上一摞红布、一碗清水、一把银针。封念师是个说话细声细气的中年人，雇了一伙刀客守门，正给一个后生封念：后生的阿妈改嫁了，他想得睡不着。红布已经盖在了罐口上。

At the end of a dead end below the sinkhole stands a bamboo hall, the sealers' headquarters. On a long table lie a stack of red cloth, a bowl of clear water and a handful of silver pins. The master sealer, a soft-spoken man of middle years, has hired swordsmen to guard the door, and he's in the middle of sealing a young man whose mother remarried and left him sleepless with missing her. The red cloth already lies over the mouth of the jar.
after: 刀客被打跑，后生的罐子还没封牢，红布一掀，后生「哇」地哭了出来，哭完说他还是想阿妈，可是心里踏实。封念师被捉住，老实交代：封进去的念认得家，罐子要当着封念的人打开，念头才会回去，「隔着人开，就散了」。阿扎听完，攥紧了怀里那根擀面杖。

The swordsmen chased off, the young man's jar isn't yet sealed tight. The red cloth comes off and he bursts into tears, and when he's done he says he still misses his mother but feels steady inside. The captured master sealer confesses: a sealed longing knows its way home, but the jar must be opened in front of the person it came from, or the longing won't go back. 'Open it away from them, and it scatters.' A Zha grips the rolling pin inside her coat.

name: 水匪埠
Marsh-Pirates' Landing
before: 泽边野地上一处旱码头，是水匪的窝，十几条平底船拴在木桩上。他们撑船在泽里转，专捞泉眼冒出来的碎罐子，拔下罐口的银针拿去熔了卖，红布晒干了当包脚布。阿扎一眼看见码头边一筐银针，扑过去就翻，水匪的竹篙兜头就扫了过来。

On the open ground at the marsh's edge lies a landing, a pirates' den, a dozen flat-bottomed boats tied to its posts. They pole about the marsh fishing out the broken jars the spring coughs up, pull out the silver pins to melt and sell, and dry the red cloth for foot wrappings. A Zha spots a basket of pins on the landing and dives in to search it, and a pirate's punt pole comes sweeping at her head.
after: 水匪被打下了水，四散逃了。一筐银针翻了个遍，没有擀面杖。泽里水一涨，就有新的水匪撑着船来捞罐子，捞一回赚一回，这一伙清了，过一阵又会来一伙，只能隔些日子来清一回。临走，阿扎把那筐银针都交给了银匠老吴，让他一根根认回原主。

The pirates are knocked into the water and scatter. The basket of pins is searched to the bottom: no rolling pin. Whenever the marsh rises, new pirates pole in to fish for jars, since every haul pays; this lot is cleared, but another will come before long, so all you can do is clear them out every so often. Before leaving, A Zha hands the whole basket to Old Wu the silversmith to match each pin back to its owner.

name: 高脚营
Stilt Camp
before: 泽地中央扎着一座高脚营，营盘架在木桩上，离水面一人多高，是蛊王的人守泉眼的营。营里的吹箭手从栏杆后面往下射，蛊骑牵着马在泥埂上来回巡，泽里的人谁也不许靠近那片白鹭最密的水面。

In the middle of the marsh stands a camp on stilts, its platforms a man's height above the water: the Gu King's post guarding the spring. Blowgunners shoot down from behind the railings, riders lead their horses back and forth along the mud dykes, and no one in the marsh may go near the stretch of water where the egrets are thickest.
after: 高脚营被你们攻了下来。俘虏说，落水洞下去的暗河从蛊王寨底下流过，蛊王在洞里拦了网，丢下去的罐子大多被网住，送到金蚕跟前；漏网的，就从这里的泉眼冒出来。「蛊王怕外人知道，」他说，「派我们在这儿守了三年。」

You storm the stilt camp. A prisoner explains: the underground river from the sinkhole runs right beneath the Gu King's village, and the King has stretched nets across it in his cave. Most of the jars dropped in are caught and carried to the silkworm; the ones that slip through come up here at the spring. 'The King doesn't want outsiders knowing. He's had us guarding it three years.'

name: 冒糠泉
Chaff Spring
before: 白鹭最密的那片泽水当中，有一眼泉，水从塘底一股股往上翻，清得见底，翻起来像锅里的水快开了。几个蛊王的吹箭手撑着竹筏守在泉边，拿长柄网兜捞水里冒出来的东西。阿扎蹲在泥埂上，一眼不眨地盯着泉眼。

Amid the water where the egrets are thickest wells a spring, pulsing up from the bottom of the pool, so clear you can see the floor, churning like a pot about to boil. A few of the Gu King's blowgunners on a bamboo raft guard it, scooping up whatever surfaces with long-handled nets. A Zha squats on a mud dyke, staring at the spring without blinking.
after: 吹箭手被打下竹筏，泉眼里正好翻上来一层黄黄的谷糠。阿扎跳起来：「是碓房的糠！」石灰岩的山被雨水溶空了肚子，水钻进落水洞，在山底下的洞里走，到老远的地方再冒出来；在进水的地方撒糠，就知道水去了哪儿。苇丛里卡着一只没破的陶罐，银针上刻着一根擀面杖。

The blowgunners knocked off their raft, the spring chooses that moment to boil up a scatter of yellow chaff, spreading in rings. A Zha leaps up. 'It's the mill chaff!' In limestone hills, rain over the ages dissolves the mountain hollow, and water that sinks into a hole runs through caves underground and comes up somewhere far away; scatter chaff where it goes in, watch where it comes out, and you know its road. Caught in the reeds is a clay jar, unbroken, the silver pin in its seal engraved with a rolling pin.

name: 抢罐坡
Jar-Snatch Slope
before: 阿扎抱着罐子往回走，到了野地的坡上，一伙封念人带着蛊骑追了上来，要把罐子抢回去：「这是蛊王的东西！」阿扎把罐子抱在胸口，蹲下来缩成一团。后面还跟来了讨念门那个妇人和放狗的北方汉子，各自抱着从罐林里取下的罐子，跑得气喘吁吁。

A Zha is carrying the jar back, and on a slope in the open a party of sealers with Gu riders catches up to take it. 'That belongs to the Gu King!' A Zha clutches it to her chest and curls up round it. Hard behind come the woman from the Asking-Back Gate and the northern dog-herder, each hugging a jar taken down from the Jar Forest, gasping for breath.
after: 封念人和蛊骑被打跑了。三个人抱着三只罐坐在坡上歇气，谁也没开。阿扎说，封念师讲了，罐要当着封念的人开，阿公在寨子里，得把他接到罐子跟前来。北方汉子挠着头说，他自己就在跟前，可他不知道该不该开：「开了，会疼吧？」

The sealers and riders chased away, the three sit on the slope to rest, three jars in their arms, none of them opened. A Zha says the master sealer told her the jar must be opened in front of its owner; her grandpa is back in the village, and she must bring him to the jar. The northern man scratches his head. He's right here beside his own, he says, but he doesn't know if he should. 'Will it hurt, opening it?'

name: 擀面寨
Noodle Hamlet
before: 蛊王寨外最后一座小寨，蛊王的一队寨丁占了寨子当粮台，寨里的米、腊肉、盐巴都被搬进了他们的仓，寨民只能吃野菜。阿扎把阿公接到了这里，老人坐在寨口笑眯眯的，什么也不问。寨丁们不许外人进寨，说这里离蛊王太近，「惊了蚕，谁担得起」。

The last little hamlet before the Gu King's village has been seized by a squad of his guards as a supply depot; its rice, smoked pork and salt are all locked in their store, and the villagers live on wild greens. A Zha has brought her grandpa here, and the old man sits at the hamlet gate, beaming, asking nothing. The guards won't let outsiders in: it's too close to the King. 'Startle the silkworm, and who'll answer for it?'
after: 寨丁被打跑。阿扎等不及了，当着阿公的面揭开了红布。阿公愣了一会儿，眼泪一下子下来了，念着「小葱，小葱」，接着一把抱住阿扎，喊了她的名字，又要过擀面杖，擀了一大锅面。就在这时，蛊王寨的洞里传来一声尖尖的长叫，大伙手腕上的金丝一齐绷紧了。

The guards chased off. A Zha can't wait any longer, and in front of her grandpa she lifts off the red cloth. The old man sits stunned for a moment, then the tears come all at once. 'Xiao Cong, Xiao Cong,' he murmurs, and then he hugs A Zha and calls her by her name. He asks for the rolling pin, sets up a board at the hamlet gate and rolls a whole potful of noodles. At that very moment, from the cave in the Gu King's village, comes a long, shrill cry, and every gold thread on every wrist pulls tight at once.
first: 抄回寨丁搬走的白米十五袋、腊肉两大挂、盐巴一驮，还有他们自己囤的一坛蜂蜜，寨民说就当是这些天的利息。

Recovered from the guards' store: fifteen sacks of white rice, two great strings of smoked pork, a pack-load of salt, and a jar of honey they'd hoarded for themselves, which the villagers call interest for their trouble.
pass: 每次路过，阿公都给你们擀一锅面，汉人的手艺，苗家的酸汤，一边擀一边说：「这是一个叫小葱的伙夫教的。」
Every time you pass, A Zha's grandpa rolls you a potful of noodles, Han craft in Miao sour soup, saying as he rolls, 'A cook called Xiao Cong taught me this.'

name: 指南石
The Pointing Stone
before: 林中岔路口有块大青石，石面上刻着一个箭头，指向南边的大山，箭头旁一行字刻得很深：「宋戈领众往南，上崖，寻镖头。」一伙蛊王的石匠在寨丁护着下，正拿錾子一点点把字凿掉。一个大脚老汉坐在石头边上骂，骂一句，往石匠脚边吐一口唾沫。

At a fork in the forest road lies a great slab of bluestone carved with an arrow pointing to the mountains in the south, and beside it a line cut deep: 'Song Ge leads the company south, up the cliffs, to find the chief.' The Gu King's stonemasons, guarded by village guards, are chiselling the words away bit by bit. A big-footed old man sits by the stone cursing them, spitting at the masons' feet after every curse.
after: 寨丁和石匠被赶跑，字只凿掉了「寻」字的半边。大脚老汉叫雷大脚，十年前就是他给千里号带的路，把他们送出蛊寨，一直送到南边的江边。「他们往南走，一个都没犹豫，」他拍着石头说，「像是早就知道镖头在哪儿。」

The guards and masons chased off, only half of 'find' has been chiselled away. The big-footed old man is Lei Dajiao. Ten years ago it was he who guided the Qianli caravan out of the Gu villages, all the way to the river in the south. 'They went south without a moment's doubt,' he says, slapping the stone, 'as if they already knew where their chief was.'

name: 南关
The South Pass
before: 林中往南的老路上有一道石关，是土司设的，关墙上站着土司最精的家兵，刀手、弩手、马队一样不少。十年前这道关是开着的，后来土司把它封了，谁也不许往南过。雷大脚说，当年他就是从这道关把马帮送出去的。

On the old road south through the forest stands a stone pass built by the chieftain, its walls manned by his finest household troops, swordsmen, crossbowmen and horse alike. Ten years ago the pass was open; later the chieftain sealed it and let no one through southward. Lei Dajiao says this is the very pass he led the caravan through.
after: 家兵被打退，关门开了。关楼里的过关簿翻到丁未年开春，有一行：「千里号马帮过关，往南，宋戈具」，后面是守关人添的小字：「众人皆手抚腕，似有物牵之。」再往后翻，第二年那一页只写着：「崖路塌，封关。」

The household troops beaten back, the gate opens. In the gatehouse the pass register, turned to the spring of the dingwei year, has a line: 'Qianli caravan through the pass, southbound, entered by Song Ge.' After it the gatekeeper has added in small characters: 'All walked with a hand on the wrist, as if something drew them.' Turn on, and the next year's page holds only: 'Cliff road collapsed. Pass sealed.'

name: 空笼楼
The Empty Cage
before: 林中一座吊脚楼，屋檐下挂着一只空鸟笼，笼门开着。主家说笼里原本养着一只绿鹦鹉，是宋戈走时寄养的。去年鹦鹉飞了，夜里在林子里乱喊，寨民以为是那个喊名字的东西，组了一队吹箭手满林子找，见绿的就射。今天他们找到了这座楼，要把笼子也烧了。

An empty birdcage hangs under the eaves of a stilt house in the forest, its door open. The family says it held a green parrot that Song Ge left in their care when he went. Last year the parrot flew off and has been shrieking in the forest at night, and the villagers, taking it for the thing that calls names, raised a band of blowgunners who comb the woods shooting at anything green. Today they've found the house and mean to burn the cage too.
after: 吹箭手被赶走，笼子保住了。主家说鹦鹉叫阿翠，学宋戈学得最像，一开口，全寨都以为宋副镖头回来了。「它喊的不是那种名字，」主家说，「它喊『跟上，跟上』，宋戈带队的时候天天这么喊。」笼底还留着几根绿毛。

The blowgunners chased off, the cage is saved. The parrot is called A Cui, the family says, and it does Song Ge better than anything; when it speaks, the whole village thinks the deputy chief is back. 'It isn't calling those names,' the man of the house says. 'It calls "keep up, keep up". Song Ge called that every day when he led the company.' A few green feathers still lie in the bottom of the cage.

name: 雷家火塘
Lei's Hearth
before: 雷大脚家的火塘边，几个土司家的家兵正在翻箱倒柜，说他当年给汉人带路、私放过关，要罚他三头牛。雷大脚的老伴拿火钳挡在箱子前头，雷大脚自己气得胡子直抖，一句话也说不出来。

By Lei Dajiao's hearth the chieftain's household men are ransacking his chests: he guided Han strangers and smuggled them through the pass, they say, and must be fined three oxen. His wife stands in front of the chests brandishing the fire tongs, while Lei Dajiao himself is so furious his beard shakes and not a word comes out.
after: 家兵被打跑，雷大脚才慢慢讲：拴了心以后，那些汉人走路跟换了个人似的，夜里不用点火把，谁走散了，摸摸手腕就找得回来。「走到江边，宋戈说丝往山上拽，镖头在上头，」他说，「他们就往崖上去了。我在江边看着，一个都没回头。」

The household men chased off, Lei Dajiao tells it slowly. Once their hearts were tied, those Han men walked like different people: no torches at night, and anyone who strayed only had to touch his wrist to find his way back. 'At the river Song Ge said the thread was pulling uphill: the chief was up there. So up the cliffs they went. I watched from the riverbank. Not one of them looked back.'

name: 麻绳院
The Rope Yard
before: 林中一个打麻绳的老匠人，院里挂满了绳子，粗的像胳膊，细的像手指。十年前千里号在他这里订过三千丈麻绳，说是上崖用的。如今一伙山外来的绳商占了他的院子，逼他把祖传的打绳法写出来，不写就不许他吃饭。

An old rope-maker lives in the forest, his yard hung with rope thick as an arm and thin as a finger. Ten years ago the Qianli caravan ordered three thousand fathoms of hemp rope from him, for the cliffs, they said. Now rope merchants from beyond the hills have taken over his yard and won't let him eat until he writes down his family's secret method.
after: 绳商被赶走，老匠人揉着饿瘪的肚子说，那三千丈绳是宋戈订的：「他说崖上的栈道断了好几截，镖头在上头修，叫他们带绳子上去。」这些年他每年还照样打一捆，码在仓里，「万一他们还要」。

The merchants thrown out, the old man rubs his empty belly and says the three thousand fathoms were Song Ge's order. 'He said the plank road up on the cliffs was broken in several places, and the chief was up there mending it, and wanted them to bring rope.' Every year since, he's twisted one more coil and stacked it in his shed. 'In case they need more.'

name: 朱砂坑
The Cinnabar Pits
before: 林中山坡上挖满了坑，一伙盗矿的把头雇了打手，逼着十几个半大孩子钻进窄坑里挖朱砂，挖出来的红石头一筐筐运出山卖。坑口拿木头撑着，撑得歪歪斜斜，孩子们一个个满脸红粉，咳个不停。

The forest slope is pocked with pits where a gang boss of illegal miners, with hired thugs, forces a dozen half-grown children down narrow shafts to dig cinnabar, and the red stone goes out of the hills by the basketful. The shaft mouths are propped with crooked timbers, and the children come up red-dusted to the eyes, coughing without end.
after: 打手被打跑，孩子们一个个从坑里拉了上来，坑口拿石头封死了。最小的一个说，夜里在坑底干活，常听见林子里有个怪声喊「跟上，跟上」，一喊，他就不怕了：「像是有个大人在前头领路。」

The thugs chased away, the children are hauled out one by one and the shafts sealed with stones. The smallest says that working down the pits at night he often heard a strange voice in the forest calling 'Keep up, keep up', and whenever it called he stopped being afraid. 'Like there was a grown-up out in front, leading the way.'

name: 蚕口坑
The Silkworm's Bite
before: 野地里忽然塌下去一个大坑，四壁陡得像刀切，往下看云雾缭绕，坑底长着一片林子，听得见水声。寨里人说这是蛊王的金蚕一口咬出来的，所以叫「蚕口」。一伙蛊骑守在坑边，向过路的人收「敬蚕钱」，不交的，就推下去「喂蚕」。

Out on the open ground the earth suddenly drops away into a huge pit, walls sheer as if knife-cut, mist drifting far below, a whole forest growing at the bottom and the sound of water rising from it. The villagers say the Gu King's golden silkworm bit it out in one mouthful, and call it the Silkworm's Bite. Gu riders stationed at the rim collect 'silkworm-honouring money' from travellers, and anyone who won't pay is to be pushed in 'to feed the silkworm'.
after: 蛊骑被打退。雷大脚趴在坑边看了半天，说这不是蚕咬的：山肚子是石灰岩，地下水一年年溶出大洞，洞顶撑不住塌下来，就成了这个坑，「坑底那股水，就是掏空山肚子的那条暗河」。当年宋戈也在这儿看过，说：「坑是水挖的，路是人走的。」

The riders driven off, Lei Dajiao lies at the rim and looks for a long time. No silkworm bit this, he says. The mountain is limestone; groundwater dissolved great caves in it over the ages, and when the cave roof could no longer hold, it fell in and left this pit. 'That water at the bottom is the underground river that hollowed the mountain in the first place.' Song Ge lay here and looked too, he says, and said: 'Water digs the pits. People walk the roads.'

name: 牛场坝
Cattle-Market Flat
before: 野地里一片牛场坝，逢场天，四乡八寨牵着牛、背着粮来赶场。坝子南头一道石门通往江边的老路，石门塌了一半。如今坝子被蛊王的寨丁占了，牛场改成了「蚕场」，赶场的人要先往蚕坛上供一把茶叶，没茶的山民被拦在坝外，粮背来又背回去。

On the open ground lies a cattle-market flat where, on market days, people from all the villages around bring their cattle and their grain. At its southern end a stone gateway opens onto the old road to the river, half fallen in. Now the Gu King's guards hold the flat and have turned the cattle market into a 'silkworm market': everyone must lay a handful of tea on the silkworm altar first, and hill folk with no tea are kept out, carrying their grain all the way here and all the way home again.
after:
寨丁被赶走，蚕坛推倒，牛场又热闹起来。坝子四周的寨子粮多石少，要修通南头的石门和江边的老路，缺的正是石头，石换粮的买卖开了张。

修路的石匠在塌了的石门底下刨出一块旧石碑，刻着：「丁未春，千里号过，修此门。」老人们说，每年正月十五夜里，南边崖上会传下来一声铃，很远，很轻。「他们还在上头，」赶牛的老汉说，「就是下不来。」

The guards chased off and the altar pushed over, the cattle market bustles again. The villages round the flat have plenty of grain and little stone, and stone is exactly what they need to reopen the southern gateway and the old road to the river, so trade in stone for grain opens here.  Under the fallen gateway the road-menders dig up an old stele: 'Spring of dingwei. The Qianli caravan passed and mended this gate.' Every year on the night of the fifteenth of the first month, the old folk say, a single bell sounds from the cliffs to the south, far off and faint. 'They're still up there,' says an old cattle drover. 'They just can't get down.'

name: 草鞋坡
Straw-Sandal Slope
before: 林中坡上住着个老阿婆，每年打一百双草鞋，托上山的人捎往南边的崖下，说崖路费鞋。今年的草鞋刚码好，一伙兵痞路过，抢去堆在坡上点了篝火烤苞谷，还笑她：「十年了，给鬼穿啊？」阿婆扑上去抢，被推了个跟头。

An old granny on a forest slope weaves a hundred pairs of straw sandals every year and sends them with anyone heading up into the mountains, to the foot of the southern cliffs, because cliff roads are hard on shoes. This year's pairs are freshly stacked when some soldiers-turned-bullies come by, pile them on the slope and light a bonfire to roast maize, jeering: 'Ten years? Who wears them, ghosts?' She rushes to save them and is shoved flat.
after: 兵痞被赶走，火踩灭了，草鞋抢下来大半。阿婆说，她的草鞋年年送到崖底，包袱年年空着捎回来，只有一回，里头夹着一张纸，包着一片茶叶，纸上写着：「鞋收到，合脚。」她把那张纸缝在了衣襟里：「人要是没了，谁会说合脚？」

The bullies chased off and the fire stamped out, most of the sandals are saved. Every year, the granny says, her sandals reach the foot of the cliffs, and every year the wrapping cloth comes back empty. Just once there was a slip of paper inside, folded round a single tea leaf: 'Shoes received. They fit.' She has sewn that paper into the lining of her jacket. 'If they were gone, who'd be telling me they fit?'

name: 寻匣客
The Box Hunters
before: 野地里一伙山外来的寻宝客，十几个人，扛着铁锹绳索，逼着寨里的猎户给他们带路往南边的崖上去。他们听说崖上有个镖头，背着一只上了三道锁的铁匣，匣里不是金子就是宝图。不肯带路的猎户被他们吊在树上，脚尖刚够着地。

A dozen treasure hunters from beyond the hills, carrying spades and ropes, are trying to force the village hunters to guide them up to the cliffs in the south. They've heard there's an escort chief up there carrying an iron box with three locks, and it must hold gold or a treasure map. A hunter who refused is hanging from a tree, toes barely touching the ground.
after: 寻宝客被打散，猎户放了下来。寻宝客的头儿揣着一张画得歪歪扭扭的图，崖上一条栈道弯弯曲曲，栈道尽头画着一个箱子，箱上一把锁。猎户啐了一口：「十年来上崖找匣子的人多了，回来的，都只剩半条命。」

The treasure hunters scattered, the hunter is cut down. Their leader carries a crooked hand-drawn map: a plank road winding along a cliff, and at its end a box with a lock on it. The hunter spits. 'Plenty have gone up those cliffs after that box in ten years. The ones who came back were half dead.'

name: 土司营
The Chieftain's Camp
before: 林中一座土司家兵的大营，几百人，横在往南的路上。营里的旗官还守着十年前的老令：南路封死，谁也不许往崖那边去。家兵的刀手、弩手、马队一层层排开，旗官站在营门口喊：「土司有令，违令者斩！」

A big camp of the chieftain's household troops, several hundred strong, sits across the road south through the forest. Its standard officer still keeps the order of ten years ago: the south road is closed, and no one goes toward the cliffs. Swordsmen, crossbowmen and horsemen deploy rank on rank, and the officer bellows from the camp gate: 'By the chieftain's order, whoever disobeys dies!'
after: 家兵大营被你们打散。傍晚，土司本人骑着马赶来，正是喝了千里号旧茶睡了三天的那一位。他当着众人收回了封路的令：「我在梦里走过那条崖路，」他说，「前头那个人一直叫我跟上。人家在上头修了十年路，我在下头封了十年，不像话。」

You scatter the camp. At dusk the chieftain himself rides up, none other than the one who drank the old Qianli tea and slept three days. In front of everyone he revokes the order closing the road. 'I've walked that cliff road in a dream,' he says. 'The man ahead kept telling me to keep up. Ten years they've been mending the road up there and ten years I've kept it closed down here. It's a disgrace.'

name: 兄弟寨
The Brothers' Stockade
before: 野地里一座寨子，寨主是一对双胞胎，长得一模一样，却谁也看不上谁，寨子当中拿竹篱隔成了两半。两兄弟手里各有半张老路图，是十年前马帮留下的，当年为了谁拿着吵翻了，一撕两半。今天两边的寨丁又在竹篱两头打起来了，你们的车正好卡在当中。

A stockade on the open ground is ruled by twin chiefs, identical in every feature, each of whom can't stand the other; a bamboo fence splits the stockade down the middle. Each brother holds half of an old route map the caravan left ten years ago; they fell out over who should keep it and tore it in two. Today their guards are brawling at both ends of the fence again, and your carts are stuck right in the middle.
after: 两边的寨丁都被打服了。你们把两半张图往桌上一拼，一张往南，一张往上：哥哥一直说马帮往南走了，弟弟一直说马帮往上走了，吵了十年，谁也没说错。两兄弟对着拼好的图看了半天，竹篱当晚就拆了。

Both sets of guards beaten into submission, you lay the two halves together on a table: one half runs south, the other runs up. The elder brother always said the caravan went south, the younger always said it went up, and they've quarrelled ten years with neither of them wrong. The twins stare at the joined map a long while, and that night the fence comes down.

name: 蚕门
The Silkworm Gate
before: 野地尽头是蛊王寨的寨门，门楼上挂着一串干瘪的蚕茧，门前排着蛊王最后的一营人马，寨丁、吹箭手、蛊骑都在。太阳快落山了，你们这才看清：门楼上方的天上，横着千百根细细的金丝，夕阳一照，亮闪闪的，从寨子里伸出去，往四面八方。

At the far end of the open ground stands the gate of the Gu King's village, a string of shrivelled cocoons hung from the gatehouse, and before it the King's last camp of men: guards, blowgunners, Gu riders. The sun is nearly down, and only now do you see it: across the sky above the gate stretch a thousand fine gold threads, glittering in the low light, reaching out from the village in every direction.
after: 门前的人马被你们打散，寨门开了。你们站在门下抬头看那些丝：大半往南，一根根绷得笔直，像拉满的弓弦；有些垂向七寨，拴着那些等人的手腕；有一根孤零零地往北去，松松地垂着。寨子深处，那尖尖的叫声又响了一下。

The camp before the gate scattered, the gate stands open. From beneath it you look up at the threads. Most run south, each pulled straight as a drawn bowstring; some droop toward the seven villages, tied to the wrists of those who wait; and a single one runs off alone to the north, hanging slack. Deep in the village, that shrill cry comes again.

name: 菌子场
The Mushroom Yard
before: 林中一片晒菌子的场子，竹匾上摊着鸡枞、牛肝菌、松茸，雨后满山的菌子都背到这里来晒。一伙从蛊王寨开小差的寨丁占了场子，不干活，专收别人晒好的干菌，转手卖出山去。采菌的山民白天上山采，晚上空着手回家。

In a forest clearing, mushrooms dry on bamboo trays, termite mushrooms, porcini, matsutake, all carried here from the mountainsides after rain. A gang of guards who deserted from the Gu King's village has taken over the yard; they do no work, just collect everyone else's dried mushrooms and sell them out of the hills. The pickers climb the hills by day and come home empty-handed at night.
after: 开小差的寨丁被赶跑，竹匾又摆满了。雷大脚说，那年开春马帮在这里晒了半个月的菌子，晒干了一袋袋背走：「宋戈说崖上什么都缺，干菌子轻，一把能煮一锅汤。」

The deserters chased off, the trays fill again. That spring, Lei Dajiao says, the caravan spent half a month drying mushrooms here and carried them off sack by sack. 'Song Ge said there's nothing up on the cliffs. Dried mushrooms weigh nothing, and one handful makes a whole pot of soup.'
first: 抄出寨丁囤的干鸡枞四袋、干松茸一小篓、一捆竹匾、两口熏菌子的瓦缸，还有他们开小差时从蛊王寨偷出来的一罐盐。

From the deserters' hoard: four sacks of dried termite mushrooms, a small basket of dried matsutake, a bundle of bamboo trays, two earthenware vats for smoking mushrooms, and a crock of salt they stole from the Gu King's village when they ran.
pass: 每次路过，采菌的山民都塞给你们一包刚晒好的干菌：「抓一把丢进锅里，比肉还香。」
Every time you pass, the pickers press a packet of freshly dried mushrooms on you. 'Throw a handful in the pot. Better than meat.'

name: 万通营
The Wantong Camp
before: 野地里一座大营，挂着「万通号」的旗，是山外一家大商号的马帮，雇了上百个镖师，堵在往南去的路口。他们的东家放话：千里号十年没回来，崖上那条路以后归万通号走，别家的马帮一律不许往南。镖师们排开阵势，嫌你们的车寒酸，笑得前仰后合。

A big camp in the open flies the banner of the Wantong Company, a great merchant house from beyond the hills, with a caravan guarded by a hundred hired swordsmen blocking the road south. Their master has announced that since the Qianli caravan hasn't come back in ten years, the cliff road belongs to Wantong now, and no other caravan may go south. The guards form up and laugh themselves silly at your shabby carts.
after: 镖师们被打散，万通号的东家跪在地上，供出一件事：每年正月，崖上会有一头老骡子独自下来，驮着一包茶往蛊寨走。九年来，他的人年年把骡子截下，茶拿出山去卖，叫「崖顶雪茶」，一两值一两金。「今年那头骡子，」他哆嗦着说，「拴在北边的草棚里。」

The guards scattered, the Wantong master on his knees confesses something. Every year in the first month an old mule comes down from the cliffs alone, carrying a bundle of tea toward the Gu villages. For nine years his men have waylaid it and sold the tea beyond the hills as 'Clifftop Snow Tea', worth its weight in gold. 'This year's mule,' he says, trembling, 'is tied up in a shed to the north.'

name: 铃丝坪
Bell-Thread Ground
before: 野地上一片开阔的坪子，头顶横过几十根金丝，从蛊王寨往南伸去。蛊王的人在每根丝上拴了一只小铜铃，派一营蛊骑守着，谁碰了丝、铃一响，就放箭。坪子边的草里，好几个过路人的帽子被射穿了，还钉在地上。

Over a wide open ground run dozens of gold threads, stretching south from the Gu King's village. His men have hung a little brass bell on every one and set a camp of Gu riders to watch: touch a thread and ring a bell, and the arrows fly. In the grass at the edge, several travellers' hats lie shot through and still pinned to the ground.
after: 守坪的蛊骑被打散。你们站在丝底下，正要走，头顶的铃忽然一齐轻轻响了一下，叮，像有人在很远的地方同时动了一动。俘虏说，铃每天都会这么响几回，蛊王拴铃，就是要听那头的人还动不动。「动，」他说，「十年来天天都动。」

The riders scattered. You're standing beneath the threads about to move on when every bell overhead rings softly at once, ting, as if people very far away had all stirred together. They ring like that several times a day, a prisoner says; the King hung the bells to hear whether the people at the far end still move. 'They move,' he says. 'Every day for ten years.'

name: 茶骡棚
The Tea-Mule Shed
before: 野地里一座草棚，棚里拴着一头老骡子，毛色灰白，背上的驮架磨得发亮，驮着一个油布包。几个万通号的伙计守着棚，还不知道东家已经跪下了，正商量着今年这包茶该卖多少钱。老骡子一声不吭，直着脖子朝南边望。

In a thatched shed on the open ground stands an old mule, grey going white, its pack frame worn glossy, an oilcloth bundle on its back. A few Wantong hands guard the shed, not yet knowing their master is on his knees, and are haggling over how much this year's tea will fetch. The old mule makes no sound, neck stretched toward the south.
after: 伙计们被赶跑，缰绳解开了。雷大脚围着骡子转了一圈，一拍大腿：这是当年马帮从寨里买走的骡子，他亲手钉的掌。骡子一松开，也不往南回，转身就朝蛊王寨的方向走，走几步，回头看你们一眼，像是在等你们跟上。

The hands chased off, the halter comes untied. Lei Dajiao walks round the mule once and slaps his thigh: this is a mule the caravan bought from the villages back then, and he shod it with his own hands. Untied, it doesn't head back south. It turns straight for the Gu King's village, walks a few steps, looks back at you, as if waiting for you to keep up.

name: 押路坡
Hostage-Guide Slope
before: 野地坡上，一伙蛊骑把雷大脚绑在了马背上，要押着他往南去：蛊王等不及了，要派人上崖，把千里号的人一个个拖下来喂蚕，非得找个认路的。雷大脚在马背上破口大骂，骂一句，马就挨蛊骑一鞭子。

On a slope in the open, Gu riders have tied Lei Dajiao across a horse and mean to drive him south: the Gu King can't wait any longer, and is sending men up the cliffs to drag the Qianli people down one by one to feed the silkworm, and they need someone who knows the way. Lei Dajiao curses at the top of his voice from the saddle, and with every curse a rider lashes the horse.
after: 蛊骑被打下了马，雷大脚被你们解了下来，揉着手腕直哼哼。他说蛊王是真急了，可急也没用：「崖路塌了，马上不去，人上去还得手脚并用。他们下不来，蛊王的人也上不去。」他望着南边：「要上去，得有人一截一截地修。」

The riders knocked out of their saddles, you untie Lei Dajiao, who rubs his wrists and grumbles. The Gu King really is desperate, he says, but desperation won't help. 'The cliff road's collapsed. Horses can't get up, and a man needs hands and feet both. They can't come down, and the King's men can't go up.' He looks south. 'Anyone who wants to go up will have to mend it, stretch by stretch.'

name: 茶包岗
Tea-Bundle Rise
before: 野地的土岗上，老骡子停下来不走了，几个蛊王的吹箭手从草里钻出来，盯上了它背上那个油布包：金蚕闻见了茶味，蛊王派人来接。他们把竹管对准了骡子的脖子，骡子一动不动，只把油布包往你们这边侧了侧。

On an earthen rise in the open the old mule stops and won't go on, and some of the Gu King's blowgunners rise out of the grass, eyes on the oilcloth bundle on its back: the silkworm has smelled tea, and the King has sent men to collect it. They aim their tubes at the mule's neck. The mule doesn't move, only turns the bundle a little toward you.
after: 吹箭手被打跑。你们解开油布包，里头是一块新压的茶砖，中间一道深槽，砖上插着一根竹片，刻着几个字：「今年的茶。人都在，路未通。宋戈。」你们算了算，这样的竹片，九年来该有九根，一根也没送到。

The blowgunners chased off, you open the bundle: a newly pressed tea brick with a deep groove down the middle, and stuck into it a bamboo slip cut with a few words: 'This year's tea. Everyone well. Road still broken. Song Ge.' You count back: nine years, nine such slips should have come down. Not one ever arrived.

name: 山货担
The Peddler's Load
before: 蛊王寨门外的野地上，一个挑山货的货郎守着两大筐货：蜂蜜、獐子皮、葛根粉、竹编的小玩意儿，都是走村串寨收来的，在这里坐了一个月，一样也没卖出去。蛊王的蛊骑封了寨门外的路，谁也不许做买卖，还天天来翻他的筐，看有没有藏着茶叶。

On the open ground outside the Gu King's gate a peddler sits guarding two great baskets of mountain goods: honey, musk-deer hides, kudzu starch, little woven bamboo toys, all gathered village by village. He's sat here a month and sold nothing. The King's riders have closed the road outside his gate to all trade, and every day they turn over his baskets looking for hidden tea.
after: 蛊骑被打跑，货郎的担子开了张，拿山货跟你们换布匹针线，算盘打得飞快。他说他走了三十年山路，从没见过蛊王这样：「一个月没出过洞，洞口的人说他瘦得只剩一把骨头，天天抱着那只蚕，跟它说话。」

The riders chased off, the peddler opens for business, trading mountain goods for cloth and needles, his abacus clicking at speed. Thirty years he's walked these mountain roads, he says, and never seen the Gu King like this. 'Not out of his cave in a month. His men say he's wasted to a bundle of bones, sits all day holding that silkworm and talking to it.'

name: 野牛坡
Gaur Slope
before: 野地坡上横着一群野牛，个个比水牯还高一头，黑亮的背，白袜子似的四条腿。蛊王的人饿急了要打它们，没打着，倒把牛群惹怒了，如今谁从坡下走，领头的公牛就低着角冲下来。老骡子要从这里过，站在坡脚刨着蹄子。

A herd of gaur blocks the slope, every one a head taller than a water buffalo, glossy black backs and four legs white as if in stockings. The Gu King's starving men tried to hunt them and missed, and only enraged the herd; now anyone who walks below the slope gets the lead bull charging down at them, horns low. The old mule has to pass this way, and stands at the foot of the slope pawing the ground.
after: 野牛被你们赶上了山梁，坡下的路空了出来。雷大脚说，这群野牛从前不拦人，老骡子年年从这里过，它们都给它让道：「牛认得骡子，骡子认得路，就是人不认得。」老骡子头也不回，从坡下慢慢走了过去。

You drive the gaur up onto the ridge and the road below clears. That herd never used to bar anyone, Lei Dajiao says; the old mule came through here every year and they always made way for it. 'The gaur know the mule, the mule knows the road. It's only people who don't.' The old mule walks slowly past below the slope without looking back.

name: 丢糕寨
Missing-Cake Hamlet
before: 野地边一座小寨，寨里的谷仓被蛊王的一队粮丁占了，米一担担往蛊王寨挑，寨民只剩野菜。更怪的是，粮丁们蒸好的糯米糕，每天早上都少几块，蒸笼边还能听见一声「跟上」。粮丁们认定是寨民偷的，把寨老绑在仓门口，要他交出贼来。

In a little hamlet at the edge of the open ground, a squad of the Gu King's grain levy has seized the granary and is carrying the rice off to his village load by load, leaving the villagers only wild greens. Stranger still, every morning a few of the sticky rice cakes the levy men steam go missing, and by the steamer you can hear a voice say 'keep up'. The levy men are sure the villagers are stealing them, and have tied the hamlet elder to the granary door until he hands over the thief.
after: 粮丁被赶走，寨老松了绑。当天夜里，蒸笼盖子轻轻一响，一道绿影一闪就上了房梁，嘴里叼着半块糯米糕，含含糊糊地说了一声：「跟上。」是只绿鹦鹉。它在梁上歪着头看了你们一会儿，扑棱棱飞出了寨子。

The levy men chased off, the elder is untied. That very night the steamer lid gives a little clink, and a green flash shoots up to the rafters with half a rice cake in its beak, mumbling round it: 'Keep up.' A green parrot. It cocks its head at you from the beam a moment, then flutters out of the hamlet.
first: 抄回粮丁搬走的白米十二担、糯米糕两笼、一缸腌酸菜，还有他们自己带来的一面铜锣，寨老说留着，以后赶鹦鹉用。

Recovered from the levy: twelve loads of white rice, two steamers of sticky rice cakes, a vat of pickled greens, and a brass gong they brought with them, which the elder says he'll keep for chasing parrots.
pass: 每次路过，寨里都给你们包几块糯米糕，还特意多包一块小的：「给那只鹦鹉留的，它要是跟着你们，就喂它。」
Every time you pass, the hamlet wraps you a few sticky rice cakes and always one little extra. 'That's for the parrot. If it's following you, feed it.'

name: 空寨楼
The Empty Hamlet
before: 你们跟着那道绿影走进一座空寨。寨里一个人也没有，吊脚楼的门都开着，火塘里的灰还是温的，织机上的布织了一半，梭子还夹在经线里。听说蛊王寨那边夜里叫得越来越凶，寨里的人前天都躲到亲戚家去了。你们在楼上歇脚，喝着自带的凉茶，谁也没说话。这时，脚下的楼板缝里，有人轻轻喊了一声赶头车的老钟的名字。

You follow the green flash into an empty hamlet. There's no one at all; every stilt-house door stands open, the ash in the hearths is still warm, cloth sits half woven on a loom with the shuttle caught in the warp. The crying from the Gu King's village has grown so fierce at night, you've heard, that everyone here went to stay with relatives two days ago. You rest upstairs, drinking the cold tea you brought, and nobody says a word. Then, from between the floorboards under your feet, someone softly calls the name of Old Zhong, who drives your lead cart.
after: 谁也没应，第一条规矩大伙都记得。你们屏着气撬开楼板，底下是那只绿鹦鹉，正蹲在一只装糯米的箩筐上。一下午你们「老钟、老钟」地喊了不知多少回，它全学会了。它冲你们眨眨眼，又换了一个声音，粗粗的，带着北边口音：「跟上，跟上。」

No one answers; everyone remembers the first rule. Holding your breath, you prise up the floorboards, and below sits the green parrot, perched on a basket of sticky rice. All afternoon you've been shouting 'Old Zhong, Old Zhong' heaven knows how many times, and it's learned every one. It blinks at you, then changes voices: deep, gruff, with a northern accent. 'Keep up, keep up.'

name: 学舌坡
Parrot-Talk Slope
before: 死路尽头的野坡上，一伙蛊王的吹箭手张着网，正围着一棵孤零零的老树往上爬，树梢上蹲着那只绿鹦鹉。蛊王听说有只鸟会学宋戈说话，要把它捉回去，让它站在崖下喊：「跟上，跟上」，好把崖上的人一个个骗下来。鹦鹉在树梢上缩成一团，羽毛都炸开了。

On an open slope at the end of a dead end, the Gu King's blowgunners have spread nets round a lone old tree and are climbing it, the green parrot huddled at the top. The King has heard of a bird that speaks in Song Ge's voice and wants it caught, to stand at the foot of the cliffs and call 'Keep up, keep up' until the people above are lured down one by one. The parrot cowers at the treetop, every feather puffed out.
after: 吹箭手被打跑，网扯烂了。鹦鹉落到你们的车辕上，正是阿翠。它歪着头想了好一会儿，用宋戈那粗粗的嗓子，一字一句地说了一段话，像是背了十年：「告诉岩公，砖别动。茶年年送下来，蚕替我们喂着。镖头在崖上修路，等路修通，我们一个一个下来还。」说完，它又用自己的嗓子补了一句：「跟上。」然后扑棱棱飞起来，朝蛊王寨的方向去了，飞几下，回头看一眼。

The blowgunners chased off, the nets in shreds, the parrot lands on your cart shaft: A Cui. It cocks its head and thinks for a long while, then in Song Ge's gruff voice recites a message word by word, as if it has rehearsed it for ten years: 'Tell Yan Gong, leave the bricks alone. We'll send tea down every year, so feed the silkworm for us. The chief is up on the cliffs mending the road, and when it's through, we'll come down one by one and pay what we owe.' Then, in its own voice, it adds: 'Keep up.' And it flutters off toward the Gu King's village, looking back every few wingbeats.

name: 金蚕洞
The Golden Silkworm Cave
before: 蛊王寨建在一个天坑边上，寨子底下就是金蚕洞。千百根金丝从洞里伸出去，大半往南，绷得笔直。洞口坐着蛊王，瘦得只剩一把骨头，胸口趴着一只拇指大的金蚕，薄得透光，丝全从它身上抽出来，也全缠在他身上。他抬起眼皮：「十年前我替他们拴了心，他们答应年年回来喂。我等了十年，蚕饿，我也饿。」他身后，寨丁、吹箭手、蛊骑一层层站起来：「把砖留下，把人留下。」

The Gu King's village stands on the rim of a great sinkhole, and beneath it lies the Golden Silkworm Cave. A thousand gold threads reach out of it, most of them south, pulled straight. At the cave mouth sits the Gu King, wasted to a bundle of bones, and on his chest clings a golden silkworm the size of a thumb, so thin the light shows through it. Every thread is drawn from its body, and every one is wound about his. He lifts his eyelids. 'Ten years ago I tied their hearts, and they promised to come back each year and feed it. Ten years I've waited. The silkworm is hungry, and so am I.' Behind him guards, blowgunners and Gu riders rise rank on rank. 'Leave the brick. Leave the people.'
after:
蛊王倒下了，洞里那只金蚕还在细细地叫。阿蔻摇着银铃上前，老骡子驮着崖上送下来的新茶走进洞。茶叶一撒，金蚕埋头就吃，吃得浑身发亮，往南的丝一齐绷紧，七寨手腕上的金丝都松了一圈。蛊王听说茶年年都送下来过，半天没出声。

只有一根丝往北，松松地垂着，没有断。你们把合好的茶砖放在它底下，丝轻轻动了一下。阿蔻说：「是空着的那一个。还活着，还在路上。」往南最粗的一根，直直地指着悬崖上的栈道。「陆镖头在上头，」雷大脚说，「等人去修路。」

The Gu King falls, and in the cave the golden silkworm is still crying faintly. A Kou steps forward ringing her silver bells, and the old mule walks into the cave with the new tea sent down from the cliffs. The leaves are scattered, the silkworm dives in and eats until it glows from end to end, and all the southward threads pull taut together, and every gold thread on every wrist in the seven villages loosens by a turn. The Gu King hears that the tea was sent down every single year, and says nothing for a long time.  Only one thread runs north, hanging slack, unbroken. You set the joined tea brick beneath it, and the thread stirs, very slightly. 'That's the empty one,' A Kou says. 'Still alive. Still on the road.' Of the threads running south, the thickest points straight at the plank roads on the southern cliffs. 'Chief Lu is up there,' says Lei Dajiao. 'Waiting for someone to come and mend the road.'
